title: Beetle Adventure Racing!
subtitle: Paradigm Entertainment / EA Canada · Nintendo 64
summary: Beetle Adventure Racing! is Paradigm Entertainment and EA Canada's Nintendo 64 racing game built around the Volkswagen New Beetle. body: Beetle Adventure Racing! is Paradigm Entertainment and EA Canada's Nintendo 64 racing game built around the Volkswagen New Beetle. The cars may share a familiar shape, but the elaborate courses provide much of the variety. Branching routes, shortcuts and hidden crates give the player reasons to explore beyond simply following the most obvious road. A first race can reveal another possibility for the next attempt. Learning the course means gradually discovering how its scenery conceals paths that alter both the journey and the chance of reaching the finish first.

Championship progress opens vehicles and tracks, while crates placed around the courses encourage finding less direct routes. A useful detour must be weighed against the time it costs, making exploration part of improving a run rather than a completely separate activity. The cars' handling gives the player a familiar point of reference as the surroundings become more elaborate. A cave, jump or gap in the scenery may lead somewhere worth remembering, turning the next lap into a chance to test the route noticed on the last.

Two players can race on unlocked courses, while Beetle Battle allows up to four competitors to collect coloured ladybugs, attack one another and escape once the set is complete. That mode turns the vehicles toward a different kind of route-finding contest. The Australian edition replaced the Volkswagens with Holden models and used the name HSV Adventure Racing. Released in 1999, the game remains distinctive for making a small car selection support unusually exploratory tracks, allowing discovery itself to become one of the skills behind a faster race.
